summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Cascade Oracle Phase 1 MVP. All backend APIs and frontend UI components tested successfully. Real USGS data integration, NOAA NWPS thresholds, risk state computation, and doctrine requirements all verified.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/system/status returns correct structure with stations_total=6, stations_with_data=6
Backend: GET /api/stations returns exactly 6 stations with valid schema and real USGS data
Backend: GET /api/stations/{id} works for all 6 station IDs (cedar-renton, snoqualmie-carnation, skagit-mt-vernon, nooksack-ferndale, green-auburn, white-auburn)
Backend: POST /api/stations/{id}/refresh works and advances fetched_at timestamp
Backend: POST /api/refresh works and refreshes all 6 stations
Backend Doctrine: green-auburn and white-auburn correctly show risk_state='unknown' with thresholds.source='thresholds_unavailable'
Backend Doctrine: cedar-renton, snoqualmie-carnation, skagit-mt-vernon, nooksack-ferndale all have thresholds.source='official_nwps'
Frontend: Dashboard loads with all components (NavBar, HeroStatusPanel, 6 station cards, PhaseRoadmap, SystemDisclaimer)
Frontend: HeroStatusPanel shows headline 'All watersheds calm' with correct KPIs (6 stations, 4 calm, 0 watch, 0 flood)
Frontend: Station cards display all required data (name, gage height, discharge, risk badge, source badge, last updated)
Frontend Doctrine: green-auburn and white-auburn cards correctly show risk='unknown' and source='thresholds_unavailable'
Frontend: Clicking station card opens detail dialog with 24h hydrograph chart showing threshold reference lines (Action 10.4 ft, Minor 13.0 ft for Cedar River)
Frontend: NavBar refresh button triggers global refresh and updates timestamp
Frontend: /roadmap route renders with full PhaseRoadmap showing all 5 phase cards
Frontend: Phase 1 is marked as 'Currently Active' on roadmap page
Frontend: SystemDisclaimer contains exact trust language ('experimental watershed intelligence dashboard', 'not an official emergency alert system')
Frontend: Data values in UI match API responses (gage height and discharge are numeric and present)
Frontend: Mobile responsiveness at 390x844 viewport (no horizontal scroll, all cards visible in single column)
